title: Morathi: Corruption of a Handmaiden
author: Rat of the Lake
description:
Overview:

This is a corruption mod for a handmaiden, captured by Morathi. She spawns after winning one battle as the Cult of Pleasure.

You unlock new models and events by unlocking skills.

-You unlock new models from the “New Armor”, “Corrupted”, “Morathi's Personal Pet” and “The Army's Slut” skills.

-These skills give events: “New Armor”, “A Well Deserved Rest”, “Corrupted”, “Lusting Officers”, “Entertainment”, “Morathi's Personal Pet” and “The Army's Slut”

You can skip events if you are not interested in them.

Additional Information:

-This is a standalone mod, but I intend for it to be playable alongside LazyIcarus's Morathi mod. So if anyone encounters any incompatibility please let me know.

-If you want to use this Hero with other factions. You could use the “console commands” mod, and you can spawn her using the command “agent champion alivia_aina”. All events and flavor is written with Morathi in mind, so it won’t make any sense, but you can if you want to.

-English is not my first language, so expect some janky grammar.

-I am way more active on Lazyicarus's discord then i am on Loverslab, if you have problems or suggestion you can tell me in the discord under the "lake-tales" channel.

Discord: <https://discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk>
